prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the attached approved adult face reference as the exact identity and preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness. Create a vertical medium-close fashion-editorial portrait from a rear-side angle: an adult woman with an elegant feminine silhouette looks back over one shoulder, her head slightly tilted and hair swept into a loose updo with wispy strands at the neck. She wears a floor-length liquid-satin evening gown with an open back and delicate crisscross straps. Keep the focus on her eyes, shoulder line, satin sheen, and open-back gown construction, set against softly draped neutral fabric with creamy bokeh. Use a soft directional key and warm rim light at approximately 3800K for gentle contour shadows and a luminous hair edge. Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.8, shallow depth, muted luxury color, subtle film grain, natural skin texture, and controlled highlights.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, minor, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: An approved-adult face and identity reference is required; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness without imitating a celebrity or public figure. The wardrobe reference is optional but, when attached, preserve the satin fabric, open-back construction, crisscross straps, and gown silhouette. The draped background may be substituted while retaining the warm luxury editorial mood.
